Neuro-sama plays The Secret of Monkey Island - Windows build

What you need
  - The Secret of Monkey Island: Special Edition, installed from Steam.
  - Python 3.9 or newer (https://www.python.org/downloads/), for the console.
  - A Neuro API server to connect to (Neuro herself, or a stand-in such as Gary).

To run
  1. Unzip this folder anywhere.
  2. Double-click console.bat. A page opens in your browser.
  3. In Settings, check the Neuro server address and the game folder
     (the usual Steam folder is filled in), then press "Start the game".

The game opens in a 16:9 window made to be captured for a stream: the game
on one side, a column about what she is doing on the other.

Savegames go to the "saves" folder here. Settings are kept in
neuro\console\console.local.json.

Keep the matching game save and journal together when copying a save slot.
For source builds and the bridge settings, see README.md.
